Lines.en: The jungle at night has more adventurers!
Lines.zh: 黑夜的丛林里有更多的冒险者！

Lines.en: I also like the jungle at night, especially when there is calm and dim light.
Lines.zh: 我也很喜欢夜晚的丛林，尤其是有恬静的、朦胧的光亮的情况下。

Lines.en: But those bugs are so annoying.
Lines.zh: 但是那些虫子太烦人了。

Lines.en: Wait， why are there so many light spots far away? Could it be those adventurer zombies have replaced the dragonflies with fireflies?
Lines.zh: 等等，为什么远处会有那么多的光点呢？难道探宝僵尸们用萤火虫取代蜻蜓了吗？

Lines.en: In fact, they didn't do that. Logically speaking, it was not necessary for zomboss to do so.
Lines.zh: 事实上他们并没有这么做，对于僵尸博士来说，从逻辑上没必要。

Lines.en: I understand. It seems that we are going to encounter many porter gargantuars.
Lines.zh: 我明白了。那看来我们要面对许多的搬运工巨尸了。

Lines.en: It seems not to be this case. I detected a different flame signal.
Lines.zh: 似乎并非如此，我检测到了不一样的火焰信号。
这种火焰来自于其他的…嗯…''宇宙''。

Lines.en: Are we going to deal with other torch guys?This is really bad.
Lines.zh: 我们要面对其他火把僵尸了吗？这真是太糟了。

Lines.en: No wonder just now a guy holding a torch and looking familiar gave me a bacon feast.
Lines.zh: 难怪刚刚有个拿火把的看着眼熟的家伙给了我一份培根大餐。

Lines.en: Then he swapped many kinds of plants with him，include all the icy plants.Even including marigold.
Lines.zh: 然后以此交换走了许多植物，其中就包括所有的寒冰植物，甚至连金盏花都被换走了。

Lines.en: Now we have no choice but to use other plants to fight.
Lines.zh: 只能被迫用剩余的植物迎敌了。

Lines.en: There were so many strange things happening tonight.
Lines.zh: 今晚发生的怪事太多了。

Lines.en: First, a guy wearing animal skin and shivering in the cold emerged from a strange portal. He blew a breath froze my plantern and ran away.
Lines.zh: 先是一个穿着兽皮冒着寒气的家伙从一个奇怪的时空裂缝里走出来，吹了口气把我的路灯花冻上就跑了。
接着又是拿火把的老兄。

Lines.en: This is bound to be a sleepless night.
Lines.zh: 看来今晚注定是个不眠之夜。

Lines.en: Combining different possibilities together is quite enjoyable...
Lines.zh: 把不同的可能性组合在一起是一种乐趣...
